title: Mergers & Acquisitions
completion_message: ¡Impresionante! El mundo de las Fusiones y Adquisiciones es uno de los más complejos y de mayor impacto en los negocios globales. Dominar esta terminología te posiciona como un profesional de finanzas corporativas de élite.

parts.visual:
Términos Clave de M&A: 
- Merger (Fusión / Cuando dos empresas se unen para formar una nueva empresa). 
Ej: The merger of the two airlines created the world's largest carrier. 
- Acquisition (Adquisición / Cuando una empresa compra a otra). 
Ej: Google's acquisition of YouTube in 2006 changed media forever. 
- Due diligence (Diligencia debida / La investigación exhaustiva que se hace antes de cerrar un trato). 
Ej: We need three months to complete our due diligence.
parts.audio: Key M and A Terms. A 'Merger' occurs when two companies combine to form a new entity. For example: The merger of the two airlines created the world's largest carrier. An 'Acquisition' occurs when one company purchases another. For example: Google's acquisition of YouTube in 2006 changed media forever. 'Due diligence' is the thorough research and investigation performed before completing a deal. For example: We need three months to complete our due diligence.

parts.visual:
Estrategias Agresivas: 
- Hostile takeover (Adquisición hostil / Cuando una empresa adquiere a otra en contra de la voluntad del consejo). 
Ej: The board rejected the bid, leading to a hostile takeover attempt. 
- Synergy (Sinergia / El beneficio adicional que se obtiene al combinar dos empresas). 
Ej: The main synergy expected from this merger is cost reduction. 
- Leverage (Apalancamiento / Uso de deuda para financiar una inversión). 
Ej: They used significant leverage to fund the buyout.
parts.audio: Aggressive Strategies. A 'Hostile takeover' occurs when an acquiring company makes a bid for a target company that is rejected by its management. For example: The board rejected the bid, leading to a hostile takeover attempt. 'Synergy' is the concept that the combined value of two companies is greater than the sum of their separate values. For example: The main synergy expected from this merger is cost reduction. 'Leverage' refers to the use of borrowed capital to increase the potential return of an investment. For example: They used significant leverage to fund the buyout.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el término de M&A correcto.

questions.question: When two equal companies join to form one, this is called a ____. (Fusión).
questions.explanation: Merger = fusión (dos empresas de tamaño similar se unen).

questions.question: When one company buys another and takes control, this is an ____. (Adquisición).
questions.explanation: Acquisition = adquisición (una compra a la otra).

questions.question: Before signing the deal, the team spent weeks doing ____ ____. (Diligencia debida).
questions.explanation: Due diligence = investigación exhaustiva previa al cierre de un trato.

questions.question: The board refused to sell, but the competitor launched a ____ takeover. (Hostil).
questions.explanation: Hostile takeover = adquisición hostil (contra la voluntad del consejo).

questions.question: The main benefit expected from combining the two companies is the ____. (Sinergia).
questions.explanation: Synergy = sinergia (1+1=3 en términos de valor).

questions.question: They took out huge loans to fund the deal. This is called financial ____. (Apalancamiento).
questions.explanation: Leverage = apalancamiento (usar deuda para financiar una operación).

questions.question: A formal offer to buy a company's shares at a specific price is called a ____. (Oferta de adquisición).
When a company buys back its shares from the market, it is a share ____. (Recompra de acciones).
questions.explanation: Share buyback = recompra de acciones propias.

questions.question: A payment made to shareholders over and above the market price to get them to sell is a takeover ____. (Prima de adquisición).
questions.explanation: Takeover premium = prima que se paga por encima del precio de mercado para convencer a los accionistas.

questions.question: When a private equity firm buys a company using mostly borrowed money, this is a leveraged ____. (Compra apalancada).
When management buys the company they work for, this is a management ____. (Compra por la dirección).
questions.explanation: Management buyout (MBO) = los directivos compran la empresa.

questions.question: The company was considered an attractive ____ for a larger competitor. (Objetivo de adquisición).
questions.explanation: Acquisition target = empresa objetivo de una adquisición.

questions.question: After the acquisition, many overlapping departments were merged in a process of ____. (Consolidación).
questions.explanation: Consolidation = consolidación de funciones duplicadas post-fusión.

questions.question: When a company sells off a non-core business unit, this is called a ____. (Desinversión).
questions.explanation: Divestiture = desinversión (venta de una unidad de negocio no esencial).

questions.question: The regulator blocked the deal, citing anti-____ concerns. (Antimonopolio).
After the hostile bid, the board used a ____ pill to make the acquisition too expensive. (Píldora envenenada).
questions.explanation: Poison pill = estrategia defensiva contra adquisiciones hostiles.

questions.question: The agreement signed after negotiations confirmed the terms and conditions of the deal. This is the ____ agreement. (Definitivo).
questions.explanation: Definitive agreement = acuerdo definitivo que formaliza el trato.

questions.question: The process of officially combining two companies after the deal closes is called ____. (Integración post-fusión).
questions.explanation: Post-merger integration = proceso de fusionar dos culturas y operaciones.

questions.question: A company that buys a majority of shares in another company has a controlling ____. (Participación mayoritaria).
The estimated total value of the deal at the time it was announced was the deal's ____. (Valuación).
questions.explanation: Deal valuation = valoración total del trato.
